# Support

## Getting help

- **Documentation:** start with the [README](../README.md) and
  [docs/01_PROJECT_GUIDE.md](../docs/01_PROJECT_GUIDE.md).
- **Questions and bug reports:** open a
  [GitHub issue](https://github.com/rodhayl/AAC_ASSISTANT/issues). Use the bug
  report template and include steps to reproduce, your OS, and relevant logs.
- **Security issues:** do **not** open a public issue. See
  [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Before you report

1. Confirm you are on the latest supported version.
2. Check the troubleshooting sections of the README and project guide.
3. Include the relevant log lines from `logs/` (redact any personal
   communication content and never paste tokens, passwords, or database files).

## What not to post publicly

- Personal or health-related communication content.
- Passwords, API keys, tokens, or `.env` contents.
- Database files or uploads.

## Expectations

This is a volunteer-maintained project. There is no paid support or guaranteed
response time. Contributions and well-scoped reports are always appreciated.
